Handheld footage shot by a person standing on a hillside terrace above the village, high vantage looking down over the village street toward the erupting volcano; slight hand shake, the camera stays fixed on the terrace, tilting down no more than slightly and never descending, the erupting volcano always visible in the upper third of the frame, a corner of the terrace railing in the foreground; one continuous shot, no zoom, no cuts. Bystanders wear civilian clothes, no hi-vis PPE; responders wear service uniforms. Raw natural light matching the weather, never glossy or CGI; no hazmat suits. No readable signs, text or flags.
